titulo_ja: カタカナ の ん
titulo_es: Read in the end and in the word

の.es: partícula de posesión o relación entre nombres
の.en: particle of possession or relationship between names

を.es: partícula que marca el objeto directo
を.en: particle that marks the direct object

bloques.titulo: It represents a nasal; its joint adapts to the sound that comes next.
texto: The sign "may appear at the end or before another consonant." In Spanish it usually approaches n, but in front of p / b it can sound closer to m.
The restaurant is close to the station.
